test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
From the alternatives given below, select the correct meaning of the idiom.

To even the score.

options.text: To avenge a wrong or make an unfair situation more equal
To score a point from a particular situation or setup
To get points equal with the opponent
To be within the distance from which scoring a goal

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **To avenge a wrong or make an unfair situation more equal**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"To even the score"** means to settle a dispute or redress a wrong by avenging or rectifying an unfair situation. (गिनती बराबर करना/बदला लेना)

 
 
• **Example:** After being cheated in the game, he was determined to even the score by winning the next round.
 
 
 
• It implies taking action to make things fair or balanced, especially after being wronged. (संतुलन बनाना)

 
 
• **Example:** She worked hard to even the score with her competitor in the final race.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **To avenge a wrong or make an unfair situation more equal**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

__
 
• **Option 2:** **To score a point from a particular situation or setup** (किसी विशेष परिस्थिति से अंक प्राप्त करना)

 
 
• **Example:** He scored a point due to his quick reflexes during the penalty shootout.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** **To get points equal with the opponent** (प्रतिद्वंद्वी के साथ अंक बराबर करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The player evened the score by hitting a six in the last over.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** **To be within the distance from which scoring a goal** (गोल करने की दूरी के भीतर होना)

 
 
• **Example:** The striker moved closer to the goal to be within the scoring distance.
 
 

1a0:T1c16,

The correct answer is **Both I and II**__.
